Rules: READ-ONLY by default (list/get/search). Any mutation (send, delete, move, share, create, update) requires an AUTHORIZED WRITE block; run it with `--dry-run` first, show the preview, then execute only the authorized operation.
Privacy: return minimal data (subject, sender, date, snippet; file names and ids). Do not dump full message bodies or document contents unless explicitly asked; never log tokens or credentials.
Discover usage with `gws <service> --help` before guessing parameters.

CliTools.Name: gws
CliTools.UseCase: Google Workspace CLI (Gmail, Calendar, Drive). Example: `gws gmail list --params '{"maxResults":5}'`. Use `--dry-run` to preview mutations.
